title: The Claude setting everyone should check
description:
comment "secure" and I'll send you my full AI Safety Checklist ⚡

Before you connect Claude to Gmail, Drive, or Slack, check this one setting first. It's part 4 of my AI safety series.
Claude lets you set exactly what every connector can do, with three options:
Always Allow, it never asks.
Ask Every Time, you approve each action.
Always Block, it can never do that.
How I run mine: read my Drive yes, delete files never. Draft emails yes, send only with my approval. Takes a minute, and the safest AI setup is the one you control.

#claude #claudeai #aisafety #aitips #aisecurity #shorts
